chapter_title_en: The Final Standings; The Number One of the Realm
chapter_seo_title: Immortal Fortunes Assembly Finale: Ji Ning Wins First Place! Full Chapter
chapter_meta_description: After a grueling year, the Immortal Fortunes Assembly concludes with three final battles. Ji Ning defeats Blackstone Recluse and Woodwood Recluse, claiming the number one spot and making history for the Black-White College.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 349: The Number One of the Realm!
og_description: Ji Ning’s relentless sword-art shatters Woodwood Recluse’s unbreakable defense. He takes the crown!
twitter_description: Ji Ning wins the Immortal Fortunes Assembly! See the final, epic clash between spear and shield.

lore_anchors.definition: A defensive technique generated by Ji Ning’s unique comprehension of the interplay between Taiyin True Water and Sunstar True Fire, manifested as a rotating barrier of water and fire.
A formation set using special staffs named after the legendary sage Fuxi; Blackstone Recluse used it to create multiple layers of sealing, illusion, and killing formations.
The premier immortal sect of the Anchan Commandery, Ji Ning’s home sect. Its victory in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly is a historic first.

A top-ten divine ability of the Three Realms, created by the Daofather Threelives. It allows Ji Ning to use his hands as ultimate weapons, greatly increasing his offensive power but consuming divine power rapidly.
